subject: PROPOSAL-1: single-file canvas game, Wired style
body:
- One index.html, inline CSS + JS, zero deps, opens via file://
- Canvas 400x600 logical, scaled to the window with devicePixelRatio
- Style: near-black sky, neon red/cyan pipes, glow, scanlines, power lines in the background
- rAF loop, gravity + flap impulse, pipes with random gap
- Box collision, states ready/playing/over, Space or click to flap
- Best score in localStorage
reviewing PROPOSAL-1
costing PROPOSAL-1
rAF-bound physics and a box hitbox on a glowing round bird. Also: glow via shadowBlur on every pipe every frame will tank cheap laptops.

subject: CHALLENGE: physics, fairness, input, tab switching
body:
1. Variable dt in rAF: plays differently at 60 vs 120/144 Hz. Fixed 1/120 s step + accumulator.
2. Box hitbox on a round, glowing bird = deaths on visible air gaps. Circle-vs-rect, radius smaller than the glow.
3. click has delay/double-fire on touch. Use pointerdown.
4. Returning to a background tab = huge dt = teleport into a pipe. Clamp dt, auto-pause on visibilitychange.
5. localStorage throws in some private modes. try/catch.
Neon glow is the budget risk: shadowBlur is expensive on canvas. Pre-render or limit it.

subject: BUDGET: glow cost + network
body:
- shadowBlur on every pipe each frame is the main perf cost. Draw the glow with layered strokes, or blur only the bird.
- Scanlines: draw once to an offscreen canvas and blit it, not 300 fillRects per frame.
- Zero network: no fonts, images or CDN. WebAudio for sound.
- No per-frame allocations. Target < 15 KB, 60 fps on an integrated GPU.

subject: PROPOSAL-2: fixed timestep, fair hitbox, cheap neon
body:
- Fixed 1/120 s physics step + accumulator, frame dt clamped to 0.25 s
- Circle (r=11) vs rect collision, visual bird r=14 + glow
- pointerdown + Space/ArrowUp/W, P pause, auto-pause on tab hide, M mute
- Pipes: pool of 4 objects, recycled, no per-frame allocation
- Neon: shadowBlur only on the bird; pipes = dark fill + 2 strokes (wide dim + thin bright)
- Scanlines + vignette pre-rendered once to an offscreen canvas, blitted each frame
- Background: power lines + distant grid, parallax, all canvas paths
- WebAudio blips, best score in localStorage with try/catch
